scientific_integrity: Uniform proof is supplied; exhaustive small-case checker is corroboration, not substitute for a proof. Independent mathematical audit is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: The exact homotopy formula is for simple bouquets of chordless six-cycles sharing a unique vertex, m>=2 and k>=4, not arbitrary cactus graphs, equivariant homotopy, or the persistence maps in k. No independent verification claimed.
title: Trinomial sphere wedges for robust clique complexes of hexagonal bouquets
